column1: # Mix a spell and then cast it - the magic pipeline end to end.
# `magic-mix` reaches the reagent surface and cancels, so nothing in the suite
# has ever completed a mix, and casting is unreachable without one: a cast with
# no charge answers `None mixed!`. This carries In Lor through mixing to a cast,
# which is the first end-to-end exercise of `magic.md`'s pipeline against the
# In Lor takes sulfur ash alone, which the shipped party carries, and needs no
# target - so the cast completes without a direction or member prompt and the
# comparison stays on the pipeline rather than on a targeting surface.
# requires-seed: the party standing on the Britannia overworld

column4: The reagent surface, In Lor selected
